name: Abu Qir Fertilizers & Chemical Industries Company (S.A.E)
source: Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries Company (S.A.E). Individual (standalone) financial statements, which is the basis the earlier years in this file use. CRON 2026-11-06: the H1 2026 column carried revenue and net profit only, so Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Profit, Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax and Income Tax were added from the issuer's filed interim statements. Source: the EGX disclosure of 2026-09-06, 'The Financial Statements (in English)', a translation of the statements originally issued in Arabic, individual statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026, read 2026-11-06. Printed, in EGP: operating revenue 23,524,557,129; cost of sales (10,552,992,790); gross profit 12,971,564,340; other income 124,167,997; selling and marketing expenses (1,211,721,401); general and administrative expenses (511,724,353); other expenses (263,182,789); expected credit losses and impairment (385,757,681); operating profit 10,723,346,113; finance income 1,045,538,802; finance cost (65,912,276); foreign currency exchange gains 12,071,285; net financing income 991,697,810; share of profit of investments under the equity method 942,853,070; net profit before income tax 12,657,896,993; income tax expense (2,646,377,087); net profit 10,011,519,905. Printed ties: revenue less cost of sales gives 12,971,564,339 against the printed gross profit of 12,971,564,340, one Egyptian pound of rounding; gross profit plus other income less the four operating expense lines equals the printed operating profit exactly; and operating profit plus net financing income plus the share of equity-method profit equals the printed profit before tax exactly. Net Finance Costs is entered as NEGATIVE 991,697,810 because the issuer prints net financing income, and the panel has one net row: finance income 1,045,538,802 less finance cost 65,912,276 plus the foreign exchange gain 12,071,285. Profit before tax also carries 942,853,070 of equity-method profit, for which the panel has no row, so operating profit plus net finance costs does not reach profit before tax on its own. Operating Expenses is derived as gross profit less operating profit, 2,248,218,227, the same convention the earlier years in this file use, which nets the printed other income of 124,167,997 into the expense line.
